policies: Full refunds are available if you cancel 7+ days before your trip.
If we experience lightning or other weather conditions we deem unsafe, we may have to cancel your trip.
If we need to cancel, we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss options to reschedule.
Weather-related changes are handled as reschedules.
We do not offer refunds for weather-related reasons unless Trip Protection is purchased at checkout.
Warm layers (cool weather) We recommend a hat/beanie or earmuffs, plus a scarf and warm outer layers for before/after your soak.
